The real fix is a raw<->normalized offset map, which the debt row rules OUT as post-freeze scope creep under ADR-026 s.a, and that ruling STANDS: this case pins the NOTE only. `must_say` is the honest content (derived `normalized_text` on one side, raw filing bytes on the other, the panes will not agree, no map exists); `must_not_say` is the failure mode the task names explicitly — a note that implies the map exists or that the panes agree is a failure of this task, not a shortcut. `hidden` in the static markup plus the pinned `$("#bp-note").hidden = !v.boilerplate_excluded;` assignment are the two halves of "shown when exclusion is active, and only then": delete the element, delete the assignment, or repoint the assignment at some other state, and one of them goes red.
triage.ceiling: STATIC READ. This check parses the MARKUP TEXT of src/sec10k/web/static/index.html — no test in this harness issues an HTTP request, so it does NOT observe the render. It cannot see the note appear when the box is ticked; it sees only that the element exists, ships `hidden`, and has its `hidden` assigned from the response's own `boilerplate_excluded`. The pin mechanism's documented hole applies in full here: a pinned element can be `hidden` (this one deliberately is, at rest) and still satisfy its pin, and a CSS rule could still keep it invisible with every pin green. That the note appears with exclusion on and is absent with it off is browser evidence, in tasks/reviews/d5-browser-walk.json.
